description:
Open a test plan as a review page in the user's browser: suites, tests, steps with their expected results, elements and gaps, with a comment box per test and Approve / Request changes buttons that write the decision into the plan. Without specFile it opens the overview of all plans in specs/ (review status, tests, generated test files, last run). Other Markdown in that folder is not a plan and is left alone. Read-only copies are saved in .selenium-ai-agent/review/ (ignored by git).

Use it after planner_save_plan: ask the user to review the plan in the page, then call it again (or read the plan) to see their decision. "approved": continue with the generator. "changes requested": read the "Review comments" in the plan, change the plan, save it and ask for a review again.
name: planner_review_plan
